annotations.title: Get a regulatory change with its revision history

description: Use when you have a record id and need to know whether the publication was amended and what changed. Returns the record in full with every revision observed since first collection. Free for 50 calls per caller each UTC day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

id.description: Record id from a search or recent result, 32 lower case hexadecimal characters. The answer shows each revision oldest first, so an amendment after publication and what moved are both visible.

name: get_regulatory_change
